types.explanation: The DESCRIBE method retrieves the description of a presentation or media object from a server. It is identified solely by the Method field in the request line.
The GET_PARAMETER method retrieves the value of specified parameters for a presentation or stream. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The OPTIONS method queries the capabilities of the server or proxy. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The PAUSE method halts stream delivery. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The PLAY method starts sending data via the mechanism specified in SETUP. It is identified solely by the Method field.

A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason set to 'end-of-stream' indicates completion or near completion of a PLAY request. The Method field identifies the request as PLAY_NOTIFY, and the Notify-Reason header further specifies the subtype.

A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason set to 'media-properties-update' indicates an update of media properties. The Method field identifies the request as PLAY_NOTIFY, and the Notify-Reason header specifies the subtype.

A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason set to 'scale-change' notifies the client about a change in playback scale. The Method field identifies the request as PLAY_NOTIFY, and the Notify-Reason header specifies the subtype.
The REDIRECT method informs a client that service will be terminated and where to reconnect. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The SETUP method creates a new RTSP session or changes transport parameters. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The SET_PARAMETER method sets the value of parameters for a presentation or stream. It is identified solely by the Method field.
The TEARDOWN method stops stream delivery and frees resources. It is identified solely by the Method field.
